title: Precision Cardiovascular Disease
summary:
Coronary artery disease is a potentially fatal condition with a chronic course. Researchers are seeking to identify previously unknown drivers of the disease.

Adult patients undergoing cardiac catheterization or another invasive procedure during an inpatient hospital stay are eligible to participate in the Precision-CVD study.

Blood samples are collected prior to the invasive diagnostic procedure. Blood, urine, and stool samples are analyzed; measurements of neck, hip, and waist circumference are taken using a tape measure; and comprehensive information about the participants is gathered via a detailed questionnaire. 

The findings from these examinations and the questionnaire are compared with the results of clinical diagnostics (cardiac catheterization or other invasive procedures, as well as any further medically necessary diagnostic tests), with the analysis being conducted also using AI-based methods.
conditions: coronary heart disease, coronary microvascular dysfunction

interventions.name: Adult patients with a cardiovascular risk profile and a wide spectrum of comorbidities undergoing elective cardiac catheterization or an electrophysiological study.
